rulePack.name: Malaysian employment-law thresholds (sources captured, values pending verification)
rulePack.notes: The instruments that set Malaysia's working-time and wage-floor thresholds, recorded so a reviewer has a work list. No value is stored here yet: employment_law_rules is empty and this pack is not approved, so no payroll can reach it. Each source below names an instrument that must be read directly; provision references are recorded only where the cited page itself attributed them.

sources.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
sources.note: AGC publishes the reprint as PDF only; the act-detail page is an amendment index and carries no section text. A reviewer must read the current reprint and record the provision for each target.

sources.title: Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980
sources.note: Title confirmed verbatim against JTKSM's official regulations index on 2026-08-08. The index offers the instrument as a download only, so the monthly overtime limit must be read from the document itself.

sources.title: Minimum Wages Order 2024
sources.note: Title and P.U. (A) number confirmed against the AGC federal legislation portal on 2026-08-08. The portal page is an index; the rate is in the order itself, which is published as PDF.
